object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: In a 27-object document, type SRS-10 in the filter box; then type watchdog; then type an object's ID, then a text no object holds, then edit that object's description to contain the text. Expected: with SRS-10, each shown row's object ID contains SRS-10; watchdog shows at least two rows; the object shows for its ID, is hidden for the text, and shows again once its description contains the text.
